race.comment: TINY PRANCER (6) has not raced for three-and-a-half months but looks forward enough for the return after three nice city trials, winning the latest. Showed ability in a short maiden prep, highlighted by a Menangle win over this distance. Expecting a bright start to the campaign. BETTOR ELEMENTS (5) has been racing well, placing at his last three starts including a third from the back row most recently at Penrith. Beaten 2.4m into second from this barrier here prior. Looks close to a win. REVVIN REYNARD (8) cops a wide barrier but placed from there two back and was good again when beaten less than 2m into second here last week. WATTS UP WOODY (2) draws much better than last time and has claims off a win at this circuit and distance three back.
